examples.japanese: {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん}が{会見|かいけん}した。
examples.english: The foreign minister held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {外務省|がいむしょう}は{渡航|とこう}{注意|ちゅうい}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a travel advisory.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長年|ながねん}{外務|がいむ}の{仕事|しごと}に{携|たずさ}わってきた。
examples.english: She has been involved in foreign affairs work for many years.

notes:
Refers to a nation's diplomatic and international relations work. Most commonly encountered in the compound {外務省|がいむしょう} (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) and {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん} (Minister of Foreign Affairs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外務省|がいむしょう}: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
- {外務|がいむ}{大臣|だいじん}: Minister of Foreign Affairs
- {外務|がいむ}{官僚|かんりょう}: foreign affairs bureaucrat
- {外務|がいむ}{職員|しょくいん}: foreign affairs staff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外交|がいこう}: diplomacy — focuses on the practice of diplomatic relations rather than the administrative domain
- {内政|ないせい}: domestic affairs — the counterpart to {外務|がいむ}
